<style>
    
    .aviao-animado {
        width: 100%;
        height: 100%;
        display: flex;
        justify-content: center;
    }
    
    .aviao-animado .elementor-widget-container {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
    }
    
    .aviao-animado .elementor-icon {
        animation: aviaoAnimado 10s linear infinite;
        /*transform: rotate(-90deg)*/
    }
    
    @keyframes aviaoAnimado {
        0% {
            transform: 
                rotate(0deg)
                translate(-307px)
                rotate(-90deg);
        }
        
        
        100% {
            transform: 
                rotate(360deg)
                translate(-307px)
                rotate(-90deg);
        }
    }
    
    @media (max-width: 767px) {
        @keyframes aviaoAnimado {
        0% {
            transform: 
                rotate(0deg)
                translate(-120px)
                rotate(-90deg);
        }
        
        
        100% {
            transform: 
                rotate(360deg)
                translate(-120px)
                rotate(-90deg);
        }
    }
    }
    
    .slider-fotos .swiper-wrapper {
        transition-timing-function: linear !important;
    }
    
</style>
